portfolio_rule: The portfolio controller reads the four owner files from current main, revalidates each against the live owner control head, active claim/lease and repair state, removes stale/non-open items from admission, and admits current READY work or selects a new owner-valid successor through the mandatory work-ahead ladder. A stale, missing, completed or blocked delegation never by itself permits idling.
day_shift_rule: Whenever a system chat closes, supersedes, blocks or materially changes its current objective, it must reconcile its delegation file in the same working session. If the previous delegation is no longer current, remove it from active_delegations, preserve closure/supersession evidence, and re-evaluate the successor before leaving an overnight-ready state.
night_start_rule: The portfolio controller performs a fresh pre-shift launch/reconciliation at 23:45 America/New_York. Each owner worker independently revalidates its selected delegation again immediately before execution; the pre-shift plan is not execution authority if state changes after planning.
dispatch_rule: CORE, LEARNING, BOOK and PROSE are each re-invoked once per hour at staggered off-hour minutes during 00:00-07:00; the portfolio controller rechecks all lanes once per hour. Within an invocation, completion or material block is followed immediately by owner re-read, evidence preservation, successor binding and further dependency-valid work while execution capacity remains.
claim_rule: Only one mutation-capable claim/lease may be live per owner lane. CLAIMED work must carry the schema-002 lease, heartbeat, checkpoint and idempotency binding. Stale claims are recovered from the last durable checkpoint after live-authority revalidation.
retry_rule: Transient dependencies receive a finite classified retry budget with backoff. After budget exhaustion the dependency is circuit-open for that invocation and the lane switches to independent safe work when any work-ahead rung remains executable.
stale_rule: No job survives a control-head mismatch by default. Preserve evidence/checkpoint, re-evaluate first, then create a new/revalidated delegation bound to the new head.
no_work_rule: Schedule nothing only after a durable all-rungs-exhausted record proves every work-ahead category is completed, duplicate, dependency-blocked, human/author/private/native/external-authority constrained, or unsafe without a decision, and proves no independent preparation can reduce tomorrow's work. Missing/stale delegation, unavailable A-01, unavailable runner, a transient dependency, completed assignment, blocked critical path or empty active list is never itself proof. Runner utilization alone is not a goal.
successor_rule: After every completion or material block, the owner worker re-reads live authority and selects the next highest-value dependency-valid unattended-safe project while time remains. Completing one project does not end the shift. A worker hitting a tool/runtime boundary must leave a current READY successor unless all rungs are durably exhausted.
utilization_rule: Per-lane append-only shift event ledgers are the authority for READY/RUNNING/BLOCKED/STALE/IDLE duration. Commit timestamps, workflow duration and runner uptime are evidence/context only and are never sufficient utilization telemetry.
value_rule: Second Shift value is measured from evidence-bearing logical work-unit advancement, evidence acceptance, autonomous successor continuation, flow/reliability and later rework. Files, commits, tokens, workflow minutes, runner uptime and artifact counts do not earn value credit. Every COMPLETED execution event records one value_work_unit using the value measurement schema, and every SUCCESSOR_BOUND event records whether the transition was autonomous and whether the established manual workflow would have required a user execution/continue turn.
time_saved_rule: Minimum Interactive Turns Avoided is the immediate hard lower-bound leverage metric. Daytime Turn Equivalent and Counterfactual Chat Elapsed Time Avoided are calculated only from observed comparable daytime calibration samples; until at least five matching work-class/complexity samples exist, the result is UNCALIBRATED rather than guessed. Human Attention Saved remains UNKNOWN until active user minutes are directly measured.
rework_rule: The morning value score is provisional while work units remain pending observation. Defect correction, invalid admission, rollback, evidence inflation correction or redo caused by wrong/stale overnight work must reduce the finalized rework/stability score; ordinary next-stage work is not rework.
